title: Macaron: Controlled, Human-Written Benchmark for Multilingual and Multicultural Reasoning via Template-Filling
findings: The 'socio-religious aspects of life' category was found to be of medium-to-low difficulty compared to other cultural aspects. Model performance on this category varied significantly, with the strongest models achieving over 90% accuracy, while smaller open-weight models performed much lower, with some around 43-45%.
references: Mikai Artetxe, Sebastian Ruder, and Dani Yogatama. 2019. On the cross-lingual transferability of monolingual representations. In Proceedings of the 57th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics, pages 4612–4624. Association for Computational Linguistics. Introduces the XQuAD dataset.
